summary_en: This study tests a virtual cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) program, the Survivorship Sleep Program, in cancer survivors with chronic insomnia. It is compared with enhanced usual care, which includes a sleep hygiene handout and a referral for CBT-I. The program is given in 4 weekly virtual sessions led by a trained facilitator, plus 1 booster session at week 6. The main outcome measured is insomnia severity.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba un programa virtual de terapia cognitivo-conductual para el insomnio (TCC-I), llamado Survivorship Sleep Program, en sobrevivientes de cáncer con insomnio crónico. Se compara con la atención habitual mejorada, que incluye un folleto de higiene del sueño y una referencia para TCC-I. El programa se ofrece en 4 sesiones virtuales semanales dirigidas por un facilitador capacitado, más 1 sesión de refuerzo en la semana 6. El resultado principal que se mide es la gravedad del insomnio.
who_for: Cancer survivors with a solid or blood cancer that has not spread, after primary treatment is complete or during current treatment.
Cancer survivors with metastatic cancer taking hormonal, maintenance, oral, or immunotherapy drugs to prevent progression.
Chronic insomnia according to DSM-5 criteria.
not_for: Self-reported inability to speak and write English.
Undertreated sleep disorder other than insomnia, such as sleep apnea.
Undertreated epilepsy, serious mental illness, or suicidality, or psychiatric hospitalization in the past year.
Unwilling or unable to stop night shift work.
